JAIBALAJI.d: Jai Balaji Industries manufactures iron and steel products, including ductile iron pipes, pig iron, and steel billets. It supplies heavy industrial components to infrastructure and construction sectors across India.

JAMNAAUTO.d: Jamna Auto Industries Limited manufactures tapered leaf springs, parabolic springs, and lift axles for commercial vehicles. It is a major supplier to original equipment manufacturers in the automotive industry.

JBMA.d: JBM Auto Limited manufactures sheet metal components, tools, dies, and buses for the automotive industry. Its main customers are commercial vehicle and passenger car manufacturers.

JIOFIN.d: Jio Financial Services provides consumer and merchant lending, insurance brokerage, and payment services. It is a financial services company promoted by Reliance Industries Limited.

JKPAPER.d: JK Paper manufactures and sells office paper, packaging boards, and specialty papers. It supplies these products to corporate offices, publishing houses, and packaging converters across domestic and international markets.

JLHL.d: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals operates multi-specialty hospitals delivering tertiary and quaternary healthcare services in Western India. It focuses on advanced medical treatments and patient care.

JMFINANCIL.d: JM Financial operates as a financial services group engaged in investment banking, mortgage lending, asset management, and wealth management. Its clients include corporations, financial institutions, high-net-worth individuals, and retail customers.

JPL.d: Jio Platforms offers digital services, high-speed wireless internet, and applications bundled with its telecom network. It operates as a subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited.

JPPOWER.d: Jaiprakash Power Ventures generates and sells hydroelectric and thermal power in India. It supplies electricity to state utilities and industrial consumers.

JSL.d: Jindal Stainless manufactures stainless steel slabs, coils, plates, and wire rods for various industrial applications. It is India's largest stainless steel manufacturer.

JSWENERGY.d: JSW Energy Limited generates and sells thermal, hydro, and renewable power. Its customers include state utilities, industrial consumers, and distribution companies across India.

JSWHL.d: JSW Holdings operates as a core investment company holding strategic investments in various companies within the JSW Group.

JSWINFRA.d: The company develops and operates ports, terminals, and maritime infrastructure facilities to handle various cargo types in India. It is a subsidiary of the JSW Group.

JSWSTEEL.d: JSW Steel Limited manufactures and sells flat and long steel products for the construction, automotive, and industrial sectors. It is one of India's largest private-sector steel producers.

JUBLINGREA.d: Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures specialty chemicals, life science ingredients, and nutritional products for pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and nutrition industries globally. The company operates multiple manufacturing facilities across India.

JUBLPHARMA.d: Jubilant Pharmova produces active pharmaceutical ingredients, solid dosage formulations, and radiopharmaceuticals for global healthcare markets. It also provides contract research and development services.

JUSTDIAL.d: Just Dial Limited operates a local search engine platform that connects users with local businesses in India. Its main customers are small and medium enterprises seeking digital advertising.

JWL.d: Jupiter Wagons Limited manufactures freight wagons, passenger coaches, and railway components for Indian Railways and industrial customers.

JYOTICNC.d: Jyoti CNC Automation manufactures computer numerical control machine tools for various engineering industries. Its main customers include the automotive, aerospace, and general manufacturing sectors.
